info.title: DAS Delivery API
info.description: DAS Delivery for one Network: line items (orders, creatives, deals, inventory and reports follow). Served on the Network host `<network>.delivery.<org domain>`. Conventions (docs/engineering/api-conventions.md): JSON in camelCase, instants in `*At` fields as ISO-8601 UTC, ids as prefixed ULIDs, money as the Money object in the Network's currency. Errors are RFC 7807 `application/problem+json` with a machine `code`. Every mutation requires an `Idempotency-Key`. Authentication is an Organization session token bound to a Network; the Network a request acts for is ALWAYS the credential's, and the host must name it (403 `NETWORK_HOST_MISMATCH`). 401 and 403 problems apply to every authenticated operation; 503 `UPSTREAM_UNAVAILABLE` when the Organisation API, which answers for the credential's Network, does not.

resources.name: lineitem
resources.description: A line item of the credential's Network: what to serve, when and for which budget. It starts as `DRAFT`. The API has no update and no delete yet (a line item is archived, never deleted): a change is refused at plan, and destroy only forgets it.

destroy.reason: A line item is archivable (P11): it is never deleted, and the API has no archive operation yet.

resources.name: ad_product
resources.description: An ad product of the credential's Network (the feature `ad-product-catalog`): a kind of advertising it sells. It starts `DISABLED`; set `status = "ENABLED"` once a `das_delivery_ad_product_version` exists. Its key never changes, and destroy switches it off (`DISABLED`): an ad product is archived, never deleted.

example.name: Homepage takeover
example.description: A full-page takeover of the homepage for one day

destroy.reason: An ad product is archivable (P11): it is never deleted, so destroy stops selling it.

resources.name: ad_product_version
resources.description: A version of an ad product's definition (the feature `ad-product-catalog`): goals, billing models, creative source and process steps. A version is immutable and becomes the ad product's current version when it is created: a changed definition is refused at plan - add a new resource instead - and destroy only forgets it.

destroy.reason: A version is immutable and is never deleted: the ad product keeps its history.

resources.name: order
resources.description: An order of the credential's Network (the feature `order-workspace`), delivered with an `ENABLED` ad product: it pins the product's current version and starts on its first step. Its name and flight change in place; its ad product, goal and billing model are refused at plan once created. Steps move with the actions `das_delivery_order_step_completion` and `das_delivery_order_approval`. Destroy cancels it (`CANCELLED`): an order is archived, never deleted; one already `COMPLETED` or `CANCELLED` is refused (409 `STEP_NOT_CURRENT`).

destroy.reason: An order is archivable (P11): it is never deleted, so destroy cancels it.

resources.name: sales_channel
resources.description: A sales channel of the credential's Network (the feature `sales-channels`): a self-service tool or a partner the Network sells through, with the ad products it offers (`ad_product_ids`) and the API keys that sell there (`api_key_ids`, each linked to one channel at most). It starts `DISABLED`; set `status = "ENABLED"` to sell through it. Its key never changes, and destroy switches it off (`DISABLED`) and keeps its links, so its keys stay narrowed to it: a sales channel is archived, never deleted.

example.name: OnetAds
example.description: The self-service tool of the Network's advertisers

destroy.reason: A sales channel is archivable (P11): it is never deleted, so destroy stops selling through it; its keys stay linked and narrowed (fail closed).

dataSources.description: One row of the audit trail of the credential's Network in DAS Delivery.

dataSources.name: audit_chain
dataSources.description: The hash chain of the Network's audit trail in DAS Delivery: its head and last verification.

dataSources.name: audit_chain_verification
dataSources.description: A verification of a segment of the Network's audit chain in DAS Delivery, computed at read.

dataSources.name: order_step_completions
dataSources.description: The step history of an order (the feature `order-workspace`): who did or decided which step, when, and how, oldest first (every page followed).

actions.name: order_step_completion
actions.description: Marks the current `WORK` step of an order done (the feature `order-workspace`). The credential must be a person's holding the step's role; the order moves to the next step, or is completed.

actions.name: order_approval
actions.description: Approves or rejects the current `APPROVAL` step of an order (the feature `order-workspace`), as an approver who did not do the work before it. Never with an API key (P9): the credential must be an approver's session.

servers.description: A Network host of the delivery module, `<network>.delivery.<org domain>`

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Client-chosen key, 1-255 printable ASCII characters (a UUID is fine). A retry with the same key and request replays the first response; the same key with a different request is 409 `IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT`.

RequestId.name: X-Request-Id
RequestId.description: Correlation id, 1-128 characters of `A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ : -`; echoed in the response. A malformed or missing one is replaced by `req_<ULID>`.

Cursor.name: cursor
Cursor.description: The `nextCursor` of the previous page, passed back unchanged. Omit it for the first page.

AwaitingMeFilter.description: `true`: only the caller's queue - orders `IN_PROGRESS` whose current step belongs to one of the roles the caller holds in the Network (an API key holds none). `false` or omitted: every order.

XRequestId.description: The request id: the client's well-formed X-Request-Id, else a generated `req_<ULID>`.

IdempotentReplayed.description: `true` when the response is the stored response of an earlier request with the same Idempotency-Key.

Forbidden.description: The credential may not do this (`NO_ACCESS`, `INSUFFICIENT_ROLE`, `INSUFFICIENT_SCOPE`, `NETWORK_CREDENTIAL_REQUIRED`, `NETWORK_HOST_MISMATCH`, `FEATURE_DISABLED`, `SELF_APPROVAL`)

InternalError.description: An unexpected failure (`INTERNAL_ERROR`); the request id names it in the service's logs

Money.description: An amount of money: a decimal string (never a JSON number) and its ISO-4217 currency.

chain.description: The chain the row is a link of: `org`, or `network:<networkId>`

seq.description: Its position in the chain, from 1 (the genesis) without gaps; null for a row written before the chain (sealed by the genesis)

prevHash.description: The hash of the link before (64 zeros for the genesis); null before the chain

hash.description: sha256(prevHash || RFC 8785 JSON of the record), lower-case hex; null before the chain

networkId.description: The Network whose trail it is; null on the org layer's

occurredAt.description: When the change committed, ISO-8601 UTC with milliseconds

action.description: What was done, `<resource>.<verb>`, e.g. `api-key.create`; `audit-chain.genesis` for a chain's first link

requestId.description: The X-Request-Id of the request that made the change

reason.description: Why, when the operation records it

changes.description: What the mutation changed, one entry per row written; null before the chain. Empty for an act that changes no row (a test email)

actorRole.description: The coarse role of the principal
